title: Dhodia in India people group profile | Joshua Project
text: The Dhodia are located in the extreme southeastern districts of Gujarat, a state in northwestern India. Their villages lie in the hilly regions south of the Tapi River. The Dhodia is the highest ranking tribe and the third-largest tribal group in Gujarat. They speak Dhodia, a Bhil language.
